profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a longtime commercial software developer--a proven high performer.
My experience includes the .NET/C#/SQL Server stack, but I'm not married to it.
I've led remote teams on agile projects.
I'm well-spoken and articulate, and I frequently interface with customers.

I recently spent 2 fun years as a teacher/coach helping high school kids learn to code.
